prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: corrected Unity gameplay projectile preview, ENEMY-015-VISUAL-PROJECTILE, hostile holy crossfire bolt. One compact directional consecrated bolt used four at a time in a cross pattern. Genuinely transparent background with every pixel outside the object fully transparent. Short pointed ivory-gold wedge pointing exactly right, broad tapered shard with a burgundy enamel core and two small symmetric side fins. Stylized 2D storybook cutout, 3/4 top-down gameplay view, thick deep-plum contour confined to the object edge, flat matte colors, simple cel shading and paper texture. Centered horizontal projectile, forward axis right. Hard clean alpha cutout; absolutely no aura, outer glow, bloom, haze, halo, light spill, trail, particles or shadow outside the silhouette; no literal cross symbol, text, ground, watermark, photorealism, 3D render or pixel art.
